content:
olga: Deploybot auto-halted publish for release-701 due to mirror job backoff. Saw intermittent ECR 429s during push chunks. anyone from infra online?

deploybot: publish-check HOLD: mirror push failed (PutImage throttled) after retries. job-id=2026-03-21-1002, backoff=exhausted. see logs: https://ci.redwood/mirror/2026-03-21-1002

devops-bot: note: eu-west-1 ECR reported elevated PutImage throttling 10m ago across org mirrors. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/ecr-throttle

nikhil: options: (1) requeue mirror with jittered retry (preferred) (2) retag existing canonical digest in target account (fast, but may lose attestation copy) (3) postpone release window and wait for regional throttle to subside.

product: window ends in 40m. we need minimal customer impact. if requeue likely <20m that's fine. otherwise we need a fallback.

olga: quick check: digest exists in origin registry; attestation present there, mirror failed before copying attestation blob. manual retag won't create attestation in target account. deploybot will block promotion without attestation. Manual attestation possible but must be recorded.

devops-bot: recommended command to requeue with exponential backoff and smaller concurrency:
```
kubectl exec -n infra mirror-runner -- /bin/mirror --repo release-701 --concurrency 2 --backoff-base 5s --backoff-max 120s --retry
```

nikhil: manual attestation commands if we need fallback:
```
# in target-account session
# copy attestation blob if available
gcloud auth login --impersonate-service-account=mirror-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
crane cp origin-attest:sha256:abcd gcr.io/redwood/release@sha256:abcd
# or sign manually
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infra/keys/release-signer gcr.io/redwood/release-701@sha256:abcd
# then approve
deploybot approve --image gcr.io/redwood/release-701 --env staging --meta manual-attest:throttle-fallback,operator:olga
```

olga: i'm kicking the requeue now with lowered concurrency. monitoring logs.

deploybot: mirror requeue started -> job 2026-03-21-1020. publish-check watching for attestation.

devops-bot: update: regional PutImage throttling subsided. mirror job completed and attestation copied.

deploybot: publish-check PASS. Promotion allowed.

product: thanks — release completed within window. please add a note to release notes: "Brief publish delay due to ECR throttling during mirror push; resolved by requeue with reduced concurrency."

nikhil: follow-up: create infra ticket to make mirror-runner auto-detect throttling and reduce concurrency in-flight. filing https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/1315
